verdict.rationale: Docs confirm ASA delivers transaction metadata over HTTP during authorization (lithic-docs-2, lithic-docs-16), and Auth Rules can act on MCC, country, currency, risk score, and even span multiple event streams including digital wallet/tokenization (lithic-docs-17, lithic-docs-24). However, there's no explicit evidence of enhanced merchant data, entry-mode granularity, partial-approval signals, or incremental-auth support in the authorization payload. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of merchant name/enhanced merchant data fields, entry-mode details, partial-approval flags, and incremental-auth signaling in the auth event schema.
